name: Datura
author: Erin Carter
description: Angel's-trumpet datura at night: two or three pendant trumpet blooms hang from an unseen branch along the top edge, glowing corolla outlines over faint translucent membranes, each long bell tapering to a five-pointed flared rim with a warm pool of light in its throat. The blooms sway on their own slow eased pendulums while throat glows breathe and fine pollen motes drift upward through the dark.

params.label: Sway
params.effect: Pendulum amplitude of the hanging blooms; 0 hangs them dead still so throat breathing and rising motes carry the motion, 1 swings them in slow visible arcs.

params.label: Breeze speed
params.effect: Rate of the sway pendulums and their noise gusts; minimum is a barely-felt night stillness, maximum a restless evening wind.

params.label: Bloom length
params.effect: Length of each trumpet bloom in CSS px from branch to flared rim; sets how far the bells reach down into the frame.

params.label: Blooms
params.effect: Number of hanging blooms along the top edge; one reads as a lone night flower, five as a laden branch.
